info.title: Paul.ez compliance API
info.description: Policy compliance service for Paul.ez. Demo data is a fictional organization's policies, not real policy, law or regulatory guidance.

schema.title: Response List Versions Api V1 Policies  Policy Id  Versions Get
Response List Clauses Api V1 Policy Versions  Version Id  Clauses Get

get.description: One clause, e.g. the clause a clarification question refers to.
The authorized original PDF. `?page=N` redirects to `#page=N` for browser viewers.

post.description: Ranked clauses with lexical/dense ranks and backend-built citations.
A short answer that cites the retrieved clauses it relies on (F06).
A follow-up detail. It takes effect when the next run starts.
Create a run and start it. Repeating the same Idempotency-Key returns the same run.

Save clarification answers and assess again with them. Only a waiting run resumes, so
a repeated request cannot launch a second attempt.

Stop further stages. A stage already waiting on the model may still finish, but its
result is never published. Canceling a finished run changes nothing.

get.description:
Server-sent events. Replays events after `after` (or the Last-Event-ID a reconnecting
browser sends), then streams new ones until the run ends. A 204 tells the browser the run
has ended and there is nothing more, so it stops reconnecting.

AssessmentStatus.title: AssessmentStatus
AssessmentStatus.description: Displayed result, chosen by the ordered rules in §5.2 (first match wins).

Citation.title: Citation
Citation.description: Built by the backend from stored clause records; models only select allowed IDs.

Confidence.title: Confidence
Confidence.description:
Evidence score computed in code from recorded checks (app/workflow/confidence.py).

A ranking of how well a verdict is backed, not a probability that it is correct.

EvidenceCoverage.title: EvidenceCoverage
EvidenceCoverage.description: Accounting for retrieved candidates, not proof that retrieval found every obligation.

FactOrigin.title: FactOrigin
FactOrigin.description: An absent fact stays `unknown`; it never becomes a negative assertion.

spans.title: Spans
spans.description: Clause spans on this page: clause_id, char_start, char_end.

ResumeRequest.title: ResumeRequest
ResumeRequest.description: Clarification answers keyed by question ID; `null` means "I don't know".

RunState.title: RunState
RunState.description: Workflow state. Model errors may switch engines; application failures stay failed.

score.title: Score
score.description: Rank-fusion score. A ranking heuristic, not a probability.

policy_ids.title: Policy Ids
policy_ids.description: Explicit user-selected scope. Omit to search every policy.

as_of.title: As Of
as_of.description: Selects versions in effect on a date.
